featured_reviews.name: Amrutha P
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was very skeptical of joining online yoga class. But as I was desperate, and info about Rajat came from a reliable source, I went on to give a try.
The very first time when I talked about my concern of the risk of online classes, he said very differently than others, "we have no other option now. Because of COVID we have to adapt to new way". He was very open (While most others went beyond limit to convince that there is no risk involved). So initially he had me by my trust 👍🏻
And when i started with the classes all the doubts went away. Each sessions are tailored to make yoga an interesting and exciting routine. There was no pressure, no extreme push, but only motivation.
I have surpassed a lot of my body limits after doing yoga with Rajat for now 3 months, and continuing.
I have taken trial classes with other instructors as well, but i didn't find them as insightful as Rajat. Unlike others, Rajat do not pressure us to keep our major focus on reaching the end result of being super flexible or super strong all at once (having some intention in your mind sort of defy the purpose of yoga, as yoga is much more than being flexible or strong). He takes us in a very comfortable pace hence I never faced any injury while doing yoga. Rather it was more relaxing, and was able to push myself more only by the techniques that naturally flow within ourselves. I couldn't believe when I did many asanas for the first time, never thought I was capable of doing them. Rajat helps us to reach to the inner power we have through his yoga mastery. His sessions include for strength, flexibility, core, balance, focus etc.. my days have become better.
Doing yoga is one thing, having that skill of teaching someone yoga is another. Rajat does excellent management of all students present in the class. Never we feel that we are not attended, which is also something I felt only in Rajat's class.

I highly recommend Rajat Dua Yoga if you are seeking for online yoga classes, especially if you are a beginner this is the best place to begin with yoga.

Thanks!!
